description: Look up Apex's precomputed knowledge indicators (Context Engine AI index apex-supplier-intelligence): verified ownership groups and corporate-group concentration, spend shares vs the third-party risk policy threshold, and per-contract clauses (change of control, disclosure duties, termination). Pass the user's question as-is in `query`. Use it FIRST for questions about suppliers, ownership, compliance risk, concentration or contract remedies.

configuration.query:
FROM ai-index-idx-apex-supplier-intelligence METADATA _id, _index, _score
| WHERE governance.lifecycle.status IS NULL OR governance.lifecycle.status == "active"
| FORK ( WHERE MATCH(title, ?query) OR MATCH(description, ?query) OR MATCH(content, ?query) | SORT _score DESC | LIMIT 20 )
      ( WHERE MATCH(title.semantic, ?query) OR MATCH(description.semantic, ?query) OR MATCH(content.semantic, ?query) | SORT _score DESC | LIMIT 20 )
| FUSE
| SORT _score DESC, _id ASC
| KEEP id, title, description, content
| LIMIT 5

query.description: The user's question, verbatim, in natural language
